dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D planar body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity white to very light grey skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light-grey clusters concentrated around the blowhole and along the midline ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between pigmented patches and the primary white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, dark-pixel punctate spots observed on the mid-lateral and posterior dorsal regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, linear surface striations and small circular hyper-pigmented marks scattered across the dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, high-contrast circular blowhole aperture.
